scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for Thrust Sectors: Scheme For Marine Products Processing Units
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must be a new or existing manufacturing or service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
Unit must have commenced commercial production between 20 May 2022 and 19 May 2027
Unit must be located in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
Enterprise must apply through the online portal within one year from the date of first loan disbursement or on or before the commercial production start date
benefits_summary: Credit linked interest subsidy of up to 60% per annum, capped at ₹5,000,000 per year for up to five years or until loan repayment, whichever is earlier.
